summary: Preview release compatibility and explicitly rebuild only incompatible node data
details: Add read-only upgrade-plan with exact source-kit matching, field differences and per-service reuse decisions; compatible activate-release also checks complete consensus identity.
Add interactive, stopped-node upgrade-release with private backups, retained old datasets, durable recovery and rollback before new services write data.

Reuse compatible Bitcoin and balance-history data; isolate indexer, chain and control-plane state for a coordinated development-network reset. Preserve keys and settings, disable old mining authorization and leave old autostart disabled until the target controller is installed.

Cross-bundle, Bitcoin/BH contract, bootstrap-mode, combined Ord migration and production-network reset transitions require separate reviewed procedures. This tooling change does not itself change network or data identities.
operator_actions: Install the target node kit, retain the old kit, and run usdb-node upgrade-plan before activation. Use upgrade-release --execute only when the reviewed plan requires a supported rebuild; follow the upgrade handbook for shutdown, backup, restart and recovery.
